author: marlon-chaviano
name: web-vue-vite
title: Web app with Vue and Vite
description: Vue's official template: Vue 3 with TypeScript, Vue Router, Pinia, tests with Vitest and ESLint, on Vite.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Components with `<script setup lang="ts">` and the Composition API. Views go in `src/views/` and routes in `src/router/`.
- Shared state in Pinia stores (`src/stores/`); local state stays in the component.
- Before finishing: `npm run build && npm run test:unit -- --run`.

service.dockerfile:
FROM node:22-slim
WORKDIR /app
RUN npm install -g pnpm bun serve
COPY {{servicePath}}/ .
RUN {{pm}} install
RUN {{pm}} run build
ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV PORT=3000
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["sh", "-c", "serve dist -l ${PORT:-3000}"]
